description:
Extend the committed determinant-companion timing evidence from its representative orders to every cell in the frozen 63-cell campaign universe. The root manifest needs an observed marginal-cost record for each cell on which it enables determinant evaluation; an interpolated or representative-order value is not a measurement at the omitted order.

## Background

The campaign protocol enables the determinant companion on all 63 core cells. The existing `dev/benchmarks/permanent_campaign/determinant-cost.csv` cohort directly measures 11 cells: four orders for each of $q=3$ and $q=5$, and three for $q=7$. Issue `7a816262` requires the frozen manifest to record the measured marginal cost per enabled cell, so the other 52 cells need a preregistered, reproducible receipt before the manifest freezes. This work extends the existing canonical determinant-cost harness and receipt; it does not create a parallel measurement format or revise permanent-backend selection.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A committed preregistration fixes the missing $(q,n)$ cells, process count, warm-up policy, repetition rule, stopping rule, fixture addressing, and pooling formula before their timing begins, with no result-dependent extension or replacement.
- [hard] REQ-02: One versioned machine-readable receipt directly measures determinant marginal cost for every one of the 63 protocol cells and retains every preregistered process outcome, including failures or censoring.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every receipt row records seeds or fixture addresses, source revision, compiler and build identity, executable hash, hardware, power policy, process and worker configuration, warm-up, timed repetitions, sample count, and elapsed determinant time.
- [hard] REQ-04: A recorded validator proves exact 63-cell coverage, the preregistered process count per cell, internally consistent pooled arithmetic, unique addresses, and agreement between the machine-readable receipt and its rendered summary.
- [hard] REQ-05: The rendered receipt reports the observed per-matrix determinant marginal cost and projected fixed-$N$ addition for every cell without presenting representative-order interpolation as measurement, and preserves any contradiction or failed process.
- [hard] REQ-06: Focused release-mode tests, formatting, and linting pass for any harness change, and the measurement receipt cites the exact producing revision and invocation.

## Notes

The existing determinant-cost harness, CSV schema, and report are canonical and are extended at their source. Measurement runs follow the repository benchmark-host protocol and timing restrictions.
title: Complete determinant marginal-cost coverage for campaign cells
